prompt:
Top-down editorial photograph of an empty warm travertine stone surface in blush-cream tones, from #F4E9E2 to #DFC7BA. Late-afternoon window light from the upper right casts long, soft diagonal shadows of window mullions and the blurred silhouette of a lotus leaf and petals across the lower left third. Fine natural stone pores, a faint linen texture at one edge, a gentle tonal gradient. Medium-format still-life photography, overhead, 50mm, f/8, soft and even. The surface is completely empty. The centre stays open and calm, ready for objects to be placed later.

House style: Warm, calm, precise; an atelier for lash and brow professionals. Cream, blush and dusty rose; soft window light from the upper right; natural stone and satin; generous negative space. Editorial beauty still life, never glossy advertising, never clinical.

Do not include: objects, products, bottles, tubes, jars, boxes, tools, flowers, petals on the surface, people, hands, text, logos, watermark, glitter, marble veins, heavy vignette. Never: products, bottles, tubes, jars, boxes, packaging or labels; text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or brand marks; faces, eyes, lashes or brows; before-and-after or treatment results; a recognisable person; stock clichés: flowers scattered on marble, fanned makeup brushes, spa stones, candles, champagne, gold glitter.

Photographic, natural, no illustration look, no AI gloss, no watermark.
